chunks: It will not decrease for them; dumb with despair they will stay in it.

key_terms.مُبْلِسُونَ: dumb with despair, mute in hopelessness

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for the inhabitants of Hell to be 'mublisun' (dumb with despair)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the eternal stagnation of the disbelievers, emphasizing that their despair (iblis) is not merely emotional but a permanent state of being cut off from divine mercy. The phrase 'la yufattaru' signifies that the intensity of their affliction does not wane, reinforcing the concept of abiding punishment in the Hereafter as a direct consequence of their rejection of truth.
